effects.name: prismaticChemtrails
effects.description: Prismatic chemtrails: a filter-style effect that looks like viewing the scene through a prism at a sky full of dissolving chemtrail wisps. ELEMENTS: (1) Radial spectral dispersion — 16-20 sample taps displaced outward from frame center, each tap's displacement scales signed (t-0.5)*dispersion*centerDist, tap color weighted by a saturated cosine rainbow palette (red outermost, violet innermost), accumulated with center-weighted Gaussian-ish weights so the frame center stays sharp and dispersion blooms toward edges. (2) Anisotropic FBM wisps — 5-octave value-noise FBM with domain stretched vertically (uv.x*1.0, uv.y*6.0) to form horizontal trail streaks, pale steel-blue/white (0.85,0.88,0.92) base tint. Wisps undulate with a pendulum drift: noise domain offset by driftAmount*sin(time*TAU) horizontally plus a second parallax layer offset by driftAmount*cos(time*TAU) moving oppositely. A gentle timeCircle vec2(cos(time*TAU), sin(time*TAU))*0.3 added to the noise coordinates gives organic undulation. (3) Iridescent sheen — where wisp density and radial center-distance are both high, wisps are tinted by the spectral cosine palette shifted by hueOffset + 0.05*sin(time*TAU*2.0); dispersion amount is wisp-modulated via mixWisp. (4) Dispersion breathing — dispersion scales by 0.8+0.2*sin(time*TAU). ANIMATION: every animated value is a pure sinusoid of time*TAU with INTEGER cycle counts (1 or 2); noise domain moves only via sin/cos oscillation and timeCircle sampling, never raw time ramps. COLOR: bright airy pastel-to-vivid — pale blue-white base interrupted by saturated full-spectrum bands; smoothstep-weighted taps, no banding, no channel-only fringing.

effects.description: A first-person infinite flight through a luminous psychedelic wormhole tunnel. Polar coordinates from aspect-corrected centered UVs: angle = atan(p.y, p.x), radius = length(p), depth = 0.3 / radius, with radius clamped to avoid center moire. Breathing flight motion: depth offset of speed * sin(time * TAU * 2.0). Whole tunnel barrel-rolls exactly 1 full integer turn per loop via rotation of centered coords by TAU * time. Vortex swirl: angle offset by swirl * depth, breathing as swirl * (0.8 + 0.2 * sin(time * TAU * 2.0)). Tunnel walls covered in flowing domain-warped FBM plasma in tunnel space (angle wrapped into 8 repeating slices plus depth term), animated via 4D noise on the timeCircle vec2(cos(time*TAU), sin(time*TAU)). Self-warp the FBM for organic liquid flow; per-octave rotate+scale domain to avoid artifacts. Depth fog exp(-depth * fog) recedes the far tunnel to black. Glow rings racing toward the viewer, brightness pulsing at 0.5 + 0.5*sin(time * TAU * 3.0). Color: IQ cosine palette, phase advancing exactly TAU * time per loop (one full seamless rainbow cycle) plus colorShift. Post-process in the same pass: gamma lift pow(color, 0.85), saturation boost via negative luma-mix, glow bloom approximation via exp/pow on bright filaments, subtle intensity pulse at 3 integer cycles. No hard edges, no tiling seams, no text. Production-quality rave music-visualizer wormhole VFX.
